profile.headline: Lead Web Developer / Cloud Engineer & ISSO | Full-Stack Development | DevSecOps
profile.summary:
I am an accomplished Lead Web Developer and Cloud Engineer with ISSO expertise, bringing 20+ years of experience delivering secure, scalable, and mission-critical software solutions in federal environments. I specialize in modern web development (Vue.js, Vuetify, Node.js, PostgreSQL), cloud technologies (Red Hat OpenShift, AWS, VMware), and DevOps automation (GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, Docker, YAML, Bash).

I’ve led cross-functional teams to modernize infrastructures, streamline CI/CD pipelines, and enhance system performance while ensuring federal security compliance with FISMA, NGA, and NARA standards. My work includes auditing and whitelisting third-party npm packages, securing multiple ATO approvals, and serving as an ISSO to safeguard enterprise systems.

I’m passionate about bridging development, cloud engineering, and security to deliver high-quality solutions that drive mission success.
